environment_findings_from_wave_1: pulp 4.0.0 in this container ships NO bundled CBC and no external MILP solver, so pulp.listSolvers(onlyAvailable=True) is empty and pulp cannot solve; its API also changed (rust core). P032 builds the pulp model for export and solves with scipy.optimize.milp (HiGHS) instead, labelled NOT RUN for the pulp leg with REQ-09 partially verified. Any future product needing an actual MILP solve must use scipy.optimize.milp. The sgp4 package ships SGP4-VER.TLE and tcppver.out in its package directory - an authoritative offline SGP4 verification vector, used by P032. Container Python is 3.13.16, not the 3.11 the build guide states; all products declare requires-python >=3.11 and CI tests 3.11/3.12. Timing, latency and benchmark numbers on this shared 1-core host move by factors of 2-13 between runs; P031, P032, P033 and P036 all label their volatile rows as such, and a coordinator re-run disagreeing on those specific numbers is the environment, not a defect.
